translations.en: We went to see @7rLady Marbas@0r.
We went to look for an important book.
@7rLady Marbas@0r is alive! Thank goodness.
But an important... book?
You hand the @3rBook of Keys@0r to @7rBeatrix@0r,
and carefully relay what @7rLady Marbas@0r
told you about its contents.
I understand.
I'll take responsibility for deciphering this book.
Huh? There's something in my pocket...
Wow! It's a gemstone!
Why? How did it get there?!
The flustered @7rTanya@0r holds a large gemstone,
shining a deep crimson.
A reward from @7rLady Marbas@0r, perhaps?
A reward? Then it belongs to you!
@7rTanya@0r only tagged along.
From @7rTanya@0r, you received a @3rCrimson Gem@0r.
Heehee. What use does an adventurer have for a gemstone?
I'll exchange it for money for you.
In exchange for the gemstone, @7rBeatrix@0r
hands you @3r100,000 G@0r.
I'll be counting on you again.
I'll start deciphering this book now.
Oh, what's the matter?
Have you finished helping @7rTanya@0r?
If you haven't,
please go and help her soon.
@7rTanya@0r was looking for you.
She seems to have something to tell you, so please hear her out.
@7rTanya@0r seems rather strange...
I hope she hasn't got herself into trouble.
@7rTanya@0r is acting strange?
Strange in what way? To see for yourself,
you should try speaking to @7rTanya@0r.
I don't really understand,
but I'm going to help @7rLady Marbas@0r!
I'll do my best!
Let's go quickly.
I want you to come to @6rStrage Labyrinth@0r.
Perfect timing.
I'd like you to come with me.
Someone is waiting for you outside the city.
I want you to hear what they have to say.
I'm coming too, so please come with me right now.
There is certainly something odd about @7rTanya@0r.
She is far too quiet, nothing like
the lively, bouncing @7rTanya@0r you know.
Come on, don't dawdle.
Hurry and come with me outside the city.
translations.note: Occurrence context in B0043.evt record 72 continues into the shared E2279 line. Complete English clauses avoid a broken sentence when E2279 occurs elsewhere.

translations.en: Could she be possessed by something?
Whatever the case, you cannot leave @7rTanya@0r
alone in this state.
With @7rTanya@0r tugging at your sleeve,
it seems you have no choice but to enter @6rStrage Labyrinth@0r with her.
You received a @3rMark of Radiance@0r.
Welcome back.
Here's your reward from @7rLady Marbas@0r.
From @7rCarmine@0r, you received a reward of @3r5,000 G@0r and
Could @7rLady Marbas@0r
translations.note: The following lover relationship is Carmine speculation, not an established narrator fact.

translations.en: have been @7rChu Lu Gah's@0r lover?
As a fairy, she'd live far longer than a human.
To keep loving someone for centuries after their death...
That's really something...
Well, that's just my own guess.
I don't know how things really stood.
Now, I suppose I'll go and help @7rBeatrix@0r.
We can't trample on @7rLady's@0r feelings, after all.
You'd better do your best too!
If even the ancient seal gets broken,
I'll beat you myself!
Train properly so that doesn't happen!
From @7rCarmine@0r, you received a reward of @3r5,000 G@0r.
Hurry up and finish the job.
Keeping a lady waiting is the worst!
Have you decided to accept?
If you're going to agonize over it,
just take the plunge and say yes.
I thought you'd say that.
She wants you to find a @3rJewelry Box@0r. A small red wooden box.

context: Tanya returns from Lady Marbas with the Book of Keys and a gemstone, behaves unusually during the request, and Carmine relays another Marbas job.
